comparison.assessment: Measured once with declared limits; settings are not tuned.

manifest.count_definition: The count is the number of independent phenol molecules and the equal number of independent N-methylacetamide molecules; it is not a count of pre-bound dimers.
manifest.interpretation: This is an integer supercell of the checked Packmol starting geometry at a declared construction density. It has not been equilibrated and is not a density prediction.

aimnet_neighbor_cutoff_a.name: aimnet_neighbor_cutoff_a
aimnet_neighbor_cutoff_a.rationale: Records the fixed checkpoint cutoff used when deriving the largest model cutoff for domain decomposition.
aimnet_neighbor_cutoff_a.scope: AIMNet2 neighbor list and DomainParallel halo

atoms_per_composition_unit.name: atoms_per_composition_unit
atoms_per_composition_unit.rationale: Records the atom count implied by the selected NCI Atlas templates so planners and result checks use the same value.
atoms_per_composition_unit.scope: planned atom counts and saved-result identity
atoms_per_composition_unit.source: Packaged Part 1 NCI Atlas subset, system 1.041.

campaign_world_sizes.name: campaign_world_sizes
campaign_world_sizes.rationale: Runs the recorded comparisons on one, two, and four GPUs. Toolkit derives a separate rank layout from each input's actual cell shape.

charge_sum_tolerance_e.name: charge_sum_tolerance_e
charge_sum_tolerance_e.rationale: Checks the total of the one predicted-charge array used by both electrostatics solvers. Larger float32 reductions report their residual separately instead of reusing this absolute limit.
charge_sum_tolerance_e.source: Part 1 numerical acceptance limit declared before measurement.

construction_density_g_cm3.name: construction_density_g_cm3
construction_density_g_cm3.rationale: Provides a reproducible starting volume; it is a construction density, not an equilibrated or predicted material density.

d3_cutoff_a.name: d3_cutoff_a
d3_cutoff_a.rationale: Matches the smoothed finite-cutoff D3 setup used in Stage 3.

d3_smoothing_fraction.name: d3_smoothing_fraction
d3_smoothing_fraction.rationale: Matches the D3 cutoff smoothing used in Stage 3.

distributed_energy_repeatability_toleran.name: distributed_energy_repeatability_tolerance_ev_per_atom
distributed_energy_repeatability_toleran.rationale: Checks that the distributed energy reduction is stable across the three measured passes. The one-GPU float32 energy spread is reported separately as a diagnostic.
distributed_energy_repeatability_toleran.source: Part 1 numerical acceptance limit declared before measurement.

domain_grid_dims.name: domain_grid_dims
domain_grid_dims.rationale: Uses Toolkit's geometry- and cutoff-based cell grid. This field does not directly set the rank layout.
domain_grid_dims.units: spatial cells along x/y/z, or automatic

domain_halo_skin_a.name: domain_halo_skin_a
domain_halo_skin_a.rationale: Adds communication depth for D3 coordination numbers around borrowed atoms; acceptance still requires same-input force agreement.
domain_halo_skin_a.source: Toolkit 0.2 multi-GPU D3 test starting value.

domain_parallel_multi_rank_warmup_force_.name: domain_parallel_multi_rank_warmup_force_prime_evaluations
domain_parallel_multi_rank_warmup_force_.rationale: Records the automatic force prime performed once before the first requested multi-rank step; it is part of untimed warmup.
domain_parallel_multi_rank_warmup_force_.scope: first multi-rank warmup run in pinned Toolkit 0.2

electrostatics_validation_molecules_per_.name: electrostatics_validation_molecules_per_species
electrostatics_validation_molecules_per_.rationale: Checks the electrostatics settings on the smaller live-example periodic box.
electrostatics_validation_molecules_per_.source: Part 1 domain campaign plan, declared before measurement.

evaluation_energy_dtype_multi_rank.name: evaluation_energy_dtype_multi_rank
evaluation_energy_dtype_multi_rank.rationale: Records the float64 energy returned by the pinned multi-rank AIMNet2 composite. Toolkit's distributed regression treats this float64 result as expected.

evaluation_energy_dtype_single_rank.name: evaluation_energy_dtype_single_rank
evaluation_energy_dtype_single_rank.rationale: Records the float32 energy returned by the pinned AIMNet2 composite when no cross-rank reduction is needed.
evaluation_energy_dtype_single_rank.source: Observed with the pinned Part 1 AIMNet2 composite.

evaluation_energy_tolerance_ev_per_atom.name: evaluation_energy_tolerance_ev_per_atom
evaluation_energy_tolerance_ev_per_atom.rationale: Checks agreement between two distributed rank layouts while normalizing the extensive energy difference by atom count.
evaluation_energy_tolerance_ev_per_atom.source: Part 1 numerical acceptance limit declared before measurement.

evaluation_force_atol_ev_a.name: evaluation_force_atol_ev_a
evaluation_force_atol_ev_a.rationale: Provides the absolute term in the declared force agreement rule.

evaluation_force_rtol.name: evaluation_force_rtol
evaluation_force_rtol.rationale: Allows the declared force limit to scale by component.

evaluation_pass_count.name: evaluation_pass_count
evaluation_pass_count.rationale: Shows three raw pass times and their median without turning the short tutorial example into a long benchmark.

evaluation_position_mic_tolerance_a.name: evaluation_position_mic_tolerance_a
evaluation_position_mic_tolerance_a.rationale: Allows only float32 roundoff from DomainParallel's automatic periodic wrapping while rejecting physical atomic motion through a minimum-image displacement check.
evaluation_position_mic_tolerance_a.source: Part 1 numerical acceptance limit declared before measurement.

evaluation_warmup_count.name: evaluation_warmup_count
evaluation_warmup_count.rationale: Runs one untimed pass after partitioning so model initialization and the multi-rank force prime are outside the three shown times.

ewald_reference_accuracy.name: ewald_reference_accuracy
ewald_reference_accuracy.rationale: Builds a direct Ewald reference with a tighter target than the production PME while keeping its estimated real-space cutoff below half the validation-box length.

fixed_molecules_per_species.name: fixed_molecules_per_species
fixed_molecules_per_species.rationale: Uses one 2 x 2 x 4 repeat of the checked base box for every GPU count so the short comparison performs the same scientific work.

live_molecules_per_species.name: live_molecules_per_species
live_molecules_per_species.rationale: Keeps the live one-GPU DomainParallel example at 3,200 atoms while using the same checked 1:1 base box as the campaign.
live_molecules_per_species.source: Part 1 domain lesson design, declared before the recorded campaign.

measured_model_evaluations_per_pass.name: measured_model_evaluations_per_pass
measured_model_evaluations_per_pass.rationale: Each measured DomainParallel run requests one BaseDynamics step after the one-time warmup.

nci_scale.name: nci_scale
nci_scale.rationale: Selects the reference-scale AB, A, and B records.

nci_system_id.name: nci_system_id
nci_system_id.rationale: Selects the same hydrogen-bonded phenol/N-methylacetamide source fragments used in Stage 3.

packmol_precision_a.name: packmol_precision_a
packmol_precision_a.rationale: Keeps optimizer precision well below the placement tolerance and defines the validation allowance.
packmol_precision_a.scope: Packmol optimizer and periodic distance validation

packmol_seed.name: packmol_seed
packmol_seed.rationale: Reproduces the one saved 128-pair placement from which every larger deterministic supercell is built.

packmol_tolerance_a.name: packmol_tolerance_a
packmol_tolerance_a.rationale: Sets the requested minimum intermolecular placement distance.

pme_accuracy.name: pme_accuracy
pme_accuracy.rationale: Derives a mutually consistent PME splitting parameter and mesh for the declared real-space cutoff.

pme_ewald_energy_tolerance_ev_per_atom.name: pme_ewald_energy_tolerance_ev_per_atom
pme_ewald_energy_tolerance_ev_per_atom.rationale: Checks equivalent periodic electrostatics routes per atom.
pme_ewald_energy_tolerance_ev_per_atom.source: Part 1 acceptance limit declared before measurement.

pme_ewald_force_max_tolerance_ev_a.name: pme_ewald_force_max_tolerance_ev_a
pme_ewald_force_max_tolerance_ev_a.rationale: Limits the largest atomic force-vector difference between the two electrostatics routes.
pme_ewald_force_max_tolerance_ev_a.source: Part 1 acceptance limit declared before measurement.

pme_mesh_safety_factor.name: pme_mesh_safety_factor
pme_mesh_safety_factor.rationale: Uses Toolkit-Ops' standard PME mesh estimate without reducing its recommended grid.

pme_realspace_cutoff_a.name: pme_realspace_cutoff_a
pme_realspace_cutoff_a.rationale: Uses the same real-space cutoff in the live, validation, and distributed periodic calculations.

pme_spline_order.name: pme_spline_order
pme_spline_order.rationale: Keeps charge interpolation identical across campaign cases.
